properties.description: Built 2026-10-17. `statement_kind` on Requirement and Constraint (add_requirement, add_constraint): a field of its own, so Requirement.kind keeps its software values. A definition or axiom reads taken as given. Reads carry `statement_reading` (kind, reads, why): `taken_as_given`, `stated` (a theorem or lemma no step concludes), `open` (a conjecture nothing shows or refutes), `refuted`, or the proof status. Two lines stated independent: `independent_of` (the other step) and `independent_except` (the lemmas both may share) on an Inference; checked — the lines may share no step other than those under the named lemmas — and read as the step's `independence`, reasoning_report's `independence`, and a `reasoning_not_as_stated` gap when false. The Phase 1 deferral: Constraint.direction has no schema default; add_constraint writes `maximum` only beside a `limit`, so a definition carries no budget words and every stored constraint keeps what it has.
properties.name: A statement says what it is (theorem, lemma, definition, axiom, conjecture), a conjecture reads refuted, and two lines can be stated independent and checked
